name: Resveratrol
description: Plant compound (3,5,4'-trihydroxystilbene) found in grapes, red wine, some berries and roots

note.text: One 30-day study in 11 obese men found calorie-restriction-like changes; larger, longer trials in women and obese men found none.

bullets: **Proposed to act on sirtuins (SIRT1) and AMPK,** linked to calorie restriction
**Extended lifespan** in yeast, worms and flies; in mice only on a high-calorie diet
**A 2012 trial in women** found no change in SIRT1 or AMPK in muscle or fat
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Many small randomized trials; results mixed

practical.pharmacokinetics: Reached the brain in an Alzheimer's trial; limited human data
practical.monitored: Insulin sensitivity, blood fats, brain MRI, amyloid

regulatory.text: GRAS notice GRN 224 stopped at notifier's request

references: Neurology, randomized trial of resveratrol in Alzheimer's disease, Oct 2015
Cell Metab, resveratrol in non-obese women with normal glucose, Nov 2012
